The structural family is ported on solo/s2a2 @282f2203 (stack: 0c254b20 seam, 84c822e9 contradictions, 60e468ba mode gate, 282f2203 reduction). alignJVM is 542/0 with fatal warnings and fmt clean. Every parity pin is green, including S2a-0 and a new base-captured ContradictionParityPin. Each commit message lists its mutants. Two of them survived the old suites and needed new witnesses: P1 (modality rule) and G4 (strict order).
- ContentScoring (contentscore.scala) now holds contradictions, engages, modeGate/modeGateWith, reduceMembers/chartReduction and Reducer.
- The shims in cost.scala (ContradictionDetector.detect/engages, ModeGate.assess, ChartDistance.reduce) project under Source and delegate.
YOUR TURN on the cost model: DefaultLocalCostModel.cost can now use ContentScoring.reduceMembers (via ChartDistance.reduction/structuralReduction, unchanged signatures) and ContentScoring.modeGate. Lexical, if not done yet: append it to ContentScoring.
REVIEW REQUEST: a SHA-bound verdict on 282f2203, which covers the seam and the three ports. Please look hardest at two things. First, the handle-generic reduceMembers: the historical H is a NodeSummary; is the provider parity airtight? Second, the Either[Set[GateReading], ...] refusal on the strict paths, since question (c) is still open.
